text: 国家统计局统计科学研究所所长闾海琪解读2025年我国经济发展新动能指数，测算显示，2025年转型升级指数为156.8，比上年增长22.7%。战略性新兴产业增加值保持较快增长；高技术制造业增加值比上年增长9.4%，比规模以上工业增加值增速快3.5个百分点，占规模以上工业增加值的比重提高至17.1%；数字产品制造业增加值增长9.3%，占规模以上工业增加值的比重为12.5%；非化石能源占能源消费总量的比重比上年提高约2个百分点；电动汽车、光伏产品、锂电池等“新三样”产品出口规模接近1.3万亿元，增长27.1%，其中电动汽车出口393万辆，增长73.1%。
text_en: Lü Haiqi, director of the NBS Institute of Statistical Science, interpreted China's 2025 new momentum index for economic development. Estimates show the 2025 transformation and upgrading index at 156.8, up 22.7% YoY. Value added of strategic emerging industries maintained rapid growth; high-tech manufacturing value added grew 9.4% YoY, 3.5 percentage points faster than industrial enterprises above designated size, with its share of industrial value added rising to 17.1%; digital product manufacturing value added grew 9.3%, accounting for 12.5% of industrial value added; non-fossil energy share of total energy consumption rose about 2 percentage points YoY; exports of 'new three' items—electric vehicles, photovoltaic products, and lithium batteries—approached 1.3 trillion yuan, up 27.1%, with EV exports at 3.93 million units, up 73.1%.
